mapper.select: SELECT curriculum.curriculum_item_id, curriculum.main_chapter_id, main.is_active AS main_chapter_active, sub.sub_chapter_id, sub.is_active AS sub_chapter_active, sub.current_content_version_id, progress.content_version_id, progress.last_page_id, progress.updated_at FROM user_learning_progress progress INNER JOIN sub_chapters sub ON sub.sub_chapter_id = progress.sub_chapter_id INNER JOIN main_chapters main ON main.main_chapter_id = sub.main_chapter_id INNER JOIN user_curriculum_items curriculum ON curriculum.user_id = progress.user_id AND curriculum.main_chapter_id = sub.main_chapter_id AND curriculum.status = 'ACTIVE' AND curriculum.completed_at IS NULL WHERE progress.user_id = #{userId} AND progress.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_curriculum_items earlier_curriculum WHERE earlier_curriculum.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND earlier_curriculum.status = 'ACTIVE' AND earlier_curriculum.completed_at IS NULL AND ( earlier_curriculum.display_order < curriculum.display_order OR ( earlier_curriculum.display_order = curriculum.display_order AND earlier_curriculum.curriculum_item_id < curriculum.curriculum_item_id ) ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sub_chapters previous_sub WHERE previous_sub.main_chapter_id = sub.main_chapter_id AND previous_sub.is_active = TRUE AND ( previous_sub.display_order < sub.display_order OR ( previous_sub.display_order = sub.display_order AND previous_sub.sub_chapter_id < sub.sub_chapter_id ) ) AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_learning_progress completed_progress WHERE completed_progress.user_id = progress.user_id AND completed_progress.sub_chapter_id = previous_sub.sub_chapter_id AND completed_progress.status = 'COMPLETED' ) OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_attempts completed_quiz WHERE completed_quiz.user_id = progress.user_id AND completed_quiz.quiz_type = 'SUB_CHAPTER' AND completed_quiz.sub_chapter_id = previous_sub.sub_chapter_id AND completed_quiz.status = 'GRADED' ) ) ) ORDER BY progress.updated_at DESC, progress.progress_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT curriculum.curriculum_item_id, curriculum.main_chapter_id, sub.sub_chapter_id, ( SELECT active_attempt.attempt_id FROM quiz_attempts active_attempt WHERE active_attempt.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND active_attempt.quiz_type = 'SUB_CHAPTER' AND active_attempt.sub_chapter_id = sub.sub_chapter_id AND active_attempt.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY active_attempt.attempt_no DESC, active_attempt.attempt_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS attempt_id FROM user_curriculum_items curriculum INNER JOIN main_chapters main ON main.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND main.is_active = TRUE INNER JOIN sub_chapters sub ON sub.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND sub.is_active = TRUE INNER JOIN user_learning_progress progress ON progress.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND progress.sub_chapter_id = sub.sub_chapter_id AND progress.status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE curriculum.user_id = #{userId} AND curriculum.status = 'ACTIVE' AND curriculum.completed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_curriculum_items earlier_curriculum WHERE earlier_curriculum.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND earlier_curriculum.status = 'ACTIVE' AND earlier_curriculum.completed_at IS NULL AND ( earlier_curriculum.display_order < curriculum.display_order OR ( earlier_curriculum.display_order = curriculum.display_order AND earlier_curriculum.curriculum_item_id < curriculum.curriculum_item_id ) ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_attempts completed_quiz WHERE completed_quiz.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND completed_quiz.quiz_type = 'SUB_CHAPTER' AND completed_quiz.sub_chapter_id = sub.sub_chapter_id AND completed_quiz.status = 'GRADED' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sub_chapters previous_sub WHERE previous_sub.main_chapter_id = sub.main_chapter_id AND previous_sub.is_active = TRUE AND ( previous_sub.display_order < sub.display_order OR ( previous_sub.display_order = sub.display_order AND previous_sub.sub_chapter_id < sub.sub_chapter_id ) ) AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_learning_progress previous_progress WHERE previous_progress.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND previous_progress.sub_chapter_id = previous_sub.sub_chapter_id AND previous_progress.status = 'COMPLETED' ) OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_attempts previous_quiz WHERE previous_quiz.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND previous_quiz.quiz_type = 'SUB_CHAPTER' AND previous_quiz.sub_chapter_id = previous_sub.sub_chapter_id AND previous_quiz.status = 'GRADED' ) ) ) ORDER BY curriculum.display_order, curriculum.curriculum_item_id, sub.display_order, sub.sub_chapter_id LIMIT 1

SELECT curriculum.curriculum_item_id, curriculum.main_chapter_id, attempt.attempt_id, attempt.status AS attempt_status FROM user_curriculum_items curriculum INNER JOIN main_chapters main ON main.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND main.is_active = TRUE LEFT JOIN quiz_attempts attempt ON attempt.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND attempt.quiz_type = 'MAIN_CHAPTER' AND attempt.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_attempts newer_attempt WHERE newer_attempt.user_id = attempt.user_id AND newer_attempt.quiz_type = 'MAIN_CHAPTER' AND newer_attempt.main_chapter_id = attempt.main_chapter_id AND ( newer_attempt.attempt_no > attempt.attempt_no OR ( newer_attempt.attempt_no = attempt.attempt_no AND newer_attempt.attempt_id > attempt.attempt_id ) ) ) WHERE curriculum.user_id = #{userId} AND curriculum.status = 'ACTIVE' AND curriculum.completed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_curriculum_items earlier WHERE earlier.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND earlier.status = 'ACTIVE' AND earlier.completed_at IS NULL AND ( earlier.display_order < curriculum.display_order OR ( earlier.display_order = curriculum.display_order AND earlier.curriculum_item_id < curriculum.curriculum_item_id ) ) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sub_chapters active_sub WHERE active_sub.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND active_sub.is_active = TRUE ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sub_chapters incomplete_sub WHERE incomplete_sub.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND incomplete_sub.is_active = TRUE AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_learning_progress completed_progress WHERE completed_progress.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND completed_progress.sub_chapter_id = incomplete_sub.sub_chapter_id AND completed_progress.status = 'COMPLETED' ) OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_attempts completed_quiz WHERE completed_quiz.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND completed_quiz.quiz_type = 'SUB_CHAPTER' AND completed_quiz.sub_chapter_id = incomplete_sub.sub_chapter_id AND completed_quiz.status = 'GRADED' ) ) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_questions question WHERE question.usage_type = 'MAIN_CHAPTER' AND question.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND question.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND question.display_order IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_questions newer WHERE newer.question_key = question.question_key AND newer.version_no > question.version_no AND newer.status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'RETIRED') ) ) AND ( attempt.attempt_id IS NULL OR attempt.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' OR ( attempt.status = 'GRADED' AND attempt.correct_count < attempt.total_count ) ) ORDER BY curriculum.display_order, curriculum.curriculum_item_id LIMIT 1
